title: All the ways a cell can die — and why the variety matters
title_zh: 细胞死亡的多种方式及其重要性
abstract: Scientists are poking holes in established ideas about how cells live and die, and are harnessing these discoveries to fight diseases from cancer to autoimmune conditions.
abstract_zh: 科学家正在挑战关于细胞生存与死亡的既定观念，并利用这些发现来对抗从癌症到自身免疫疾病等多种疾病。
snippet: Scientists are poking holes in established ideas about how cells live and die, and are harnessing these discoveries to fight diseases from cancer to autoimmune conditions.
